title: Annual Unit Limits by Prior Authorization Class
content:
Two Prior Authorization classes at Prairie Ridge Health Plan cap the units granted to one member in a calendar year; the other five set no annual limit. Where a limit applies, it is counted per member, per calendar year and per the basis shown, and members under age 21 on the service date are exempt from unit and annual limits under EPSDT in every class.

| Class | Annual limit applies | Most units per member per calendar year | Counted per | Members under 21 exempt from unit and annual limits |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | Yes |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | Yes | 30 | therapy discipline | Yes |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | Yes |
| Home Health Services Authorization | Yes | 100 | service type | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | Yes |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | Yes |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | No | 0 (not applicable) | not applicable | Yes |

## Basis questions

**What does "counted per therapy discipline" mean for Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization?** The 30 units are counted separately for each therapy discipline, so the units granted to a member in one calendar year for one discipline are measured against 30 on their own.

**What does "counted per service type" mean for Home Health Services Authorization?** The 100 units are counted per service type within the class for the calendar year.

**Does a figure of 0 mean no units may be granted?** No. In the classes marked "No" the annual limit does not apply, and the 0 records only that there is no annual figure.

**Hypothetical reading.** For a hypothetical member aged 30, Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization units for physical therapy are measured against 30 for the calendar year; for the same member, Advanced Imaging Authorization studies are measured against no annual figure at all.
